question: ______ is an electronic payment system that enables customers of a bank or other financial institution to conduct a range of financial transactions through the financial institution's website.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Internet banking.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Internet banking** is also known as **online banking or e-banking.**
 
• It **allows customers** to **perform** various financial transactions such as c**hecking account balances, transferring funds, paying bills, and applying for loans **through the bank's website.
 
• Internet banking is a convenient and secure way for customers to manage their finances **without having to visit a bank branch**.
 
• Some of the benefits of internet banking include 24/7 access to account information, faster transactions, and lower fees compared to traditional banking methods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Interstate banking** refers to the **ability of banks to operate branches in multiple states**. This allows banks to expand their reach and offer their services to customers in different regions.
 
• A s**ingle-entry system** is an **accounting method** where each **financial transaction is recorded only once**, either as a debit or a credit. This method is **simpler than double-entry** accounting and is often used by small businesses.
 
• **Inter-corporate banking** refers to** financial transactions between two or more corporations**. This can include loans, investments, and other financial services.
